clue.text: Wise old Greek gets emergency call about case

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other, here the call wrapping the case

parts.note: SOS is the international distress signal
a crate is a packing case

explanation.surface: An ancient philosopher dials for help over a legal case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Case' suggests a lawsuit, but here it is a packing box.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian philosopher was famously wise and is an obvious example of an ancient thinker.

clue.text: Old boy has desire to be not quite square

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
to long is to desire

explanation.surface: A former pupil longs to be a little less conventional.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Square' looks like slang for stuffy, but it is the shape: a rectangle is nearly a square.
explanation.definitionFit: A rectangle with unequal sides is almost, but not exactly, a square shape.

clue.text: Take part in drive round water

indicators.note: Take part in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An invitation to join a drive around a lake or reservoir.
explanation.definitionFit: A flowing stream is a body of water, as in a map's blue lines.

clue.text: Apparently senseless communication

parts.note: senseless looks like meaning nonsensical, but it means passing thoughts without using any of the five senses

explanation.surface: Someone's talk seems to make no sense at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Mind-to-mind messaging supposedly happens without sight, hearing or any other sense organ.

clue.text: Read boy's upbringing is a disgrace

parts.note: to scan is to read through

indicators.note: in a down clue, bringing up a word means writing it from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: Reading about how a boy was raised reveals something shameful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upbringing' turns LAD upside down to DAL in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A public outrage or shameful affair is a disgrace.

clue.text: London hall has chain across the front

definitions.meaning: the Royal ... Hall, a famous London concert venue
a watch chain worn across a waistcoat front

explanation.surface: A concert venue has a chain stretched over its entrance.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kensington concert venue bears the prince consort's name, as does a Victorian waistcoat watch chain.

clue.text: Notice politician's departure from text

parts.note: an ad is a notice, an advertisement
Lib is short for a Liberal politician

explanation.surface: A politician is seen to stray from the prepared speech.
explanation.walkthrough: LIB is a Liberal, a member of a British political party.
explanation.definitionFit: An improvised remark is one not in the script.

clue.text: Restaurant's supporters, an endless sequence

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so the clue reads restaurant is ...

parts.note: bras are supporting undergarments

indicators.note: endless says the final letter of the sequence word is cut off

parts.note: a series is a sequence

explanation.surface: A restaurant's backers run an unending chain of events.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts the last S from SERIES, leaving SERIE.
explanation.definitionFit: A French-style eatery serving simple meals is a kind of restaurant.

clue.text: Judge gave transcript to monarch

parts.note: to record is to put something down as a transcript
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword monarch

explanation.surface: A judge hands a court transcript to the king or queen.
explanation.walkthrough: In England a Recorder is a part-time judge.
explanation.definitionFit: In English courts a Recorder is a barrister sitting as a part-time judge.

clue.text: Exam entirely in the evening? The opposite

indicators.note: in, read with the reversal instruction that follows, puts one word inside the other
The opposite says to swap the order the clue states, so the evening goes inside the word for entirely

parts.note: all means entirely
eve is the evening

explanation.surface: Sitting an exam late at night, it seems.
explanation.walkthrough: Read literally the clue puts the word for entirely inside the evening; 'The opposite' reverses which goes inside which. An A level is a British school-leaving exam taken at about eighteen.
explanation.definitionFit: Advanced level is the British school qualification taken at the end of secondary education.

clue.text: Everyone needs a nice exciting marriage

parts.note: all means everyone

indicators.note: exciting means stirring up, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Everyone wants a lovely, thrilling wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: A union or partnership, especially by marriage, is an alliance.

clue.text: I printed out in bold

indicators.note: out means the letters are put out of order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone announces, proudly, that they printed something in bold type.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bold' looks like the typeface, but it means brave.
explanation.definitionFit: A fearless person is daring, brave and courageous.

clue.text: Wanting some grub, I strode into cafe

indicators.note: Wanting some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Hungry, I marched into a cafe.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition 'into cafe' was wrong: 'into' is a link word and the definition is 'cafe' alone.
explanation.definitionFit: A small informal restaurant serving simple food is a kind of cafe.

clue.text: Stock exchange

parts.note: stock looks like shares, but here it means farm livestock being traded

explanation.surface: A financial market for trading shares.
explanation.definitionFit: Livestock is bought and sold at an auction yard for farm animals.

clue.text: Abandon demand descend

definitions.meaning: to back down from a position or claim
to come down from a height, as from a ladder

explanation.surface: Give up on a request and go downstairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Backing down in an argument and literally coming down a ladder share the same phrase.

clue.text: Chary working with mine equipment

indicators.note: working means set in motion, so the letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Cautious work in a mine with the gear.
explanation.definitionFit: Machines and their parts collectively make up plant or apparatus.

clue.text: Flower round a lot of yards is a tea plant

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river: the Cam flows through Cambridge
O is round in shape
a mile is 1760 yards, a lot of them

explanation.surface: A bloom circling a garden plot is a herb used for tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is a crossword joke: a thing that flows, a river, here the Cam in Cambridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Its daisy-like heads are dried and steeped to make a herbal tea.

clue.text: In which one has relatives round?

definitions.text: In which one has relatives round?

parts.words: In which one has relatives round?
parts.note: relatives round sounds like a visit, but it is a ring of kin surrounding one

explanation.surface: Where do you entertain visiting relations?
explanation.definitionFit: One's close kin form a ring of people around a person.

clue.text: Covered in skilful depth

parts.note: taken as written
sure means steady and skilful, as in a sure touch

explanation.surface: Protected in deep water by one's own skill.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a policy against loss means being protected financially.

clue.text: After an alcoholic drink, a pain in the chest

parts.note: gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Chest pain follows a stiff drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A heart condition causing sharp discomfort behind the breastbone.

clue.text: Struggle to get doctor into jacket

indicators.note: into means one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: a coat is an outer jacket
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree

explanation.surface: It's a fight to get a doctor into a jacket.
explanation.definitionFit: Fighting or conflict is a struggle.

clue.text: Mainly susceptible to heavenly attraction

definitions.meaning: jokily, of the main, the open sea

explanation.surface: Mostly open to romance from above.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mainly' looks like 'mostly' but is read as 'of the main', the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Ocean waters are of the sea and rise and fall under the moon's gravitational pull.

clue.text: Going past bottom of wall

definitions.meaning: passing around the edge of something
the board running along the base of an interior wall

explanation.surface: Passing by the foot of a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: Edging round an obstacle and the board along a wall's base are both this word.

clue.text: Child has a pound-the whole amount

parts.note: a tot is a small child
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling

explanation.surface: A child has a pound coin, all the money they own.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum of everything added up is the complete amount.

clue.text: Girl's command causes confusion

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, so Di's
an order is a command

explanation.surface: A girl's instruction leads to chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: A muddle or lack of order is confusion.

clue.text: Place restrictions on estate, at line newly made

indicators.note: newly made means the letters are remade in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Restricting a property's inheritance by drawing a new line.
explanation.walkthrough: The OCR dropped 'on'. 'newly made' rearranges AT LINE.
explanation.definitionFit: To settle land so it can pass only to specified heirs restricts how the property is inherited.

clue.text: In part of the ship, sailors are the important part

indicators.note: In puts the sailors inside the ship part

parts.note: the keel is the spine along a ship's bottom
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: Sailors are the vital part of the ship's crew.
explanation.definitionFit: The core or essence of something is its most important part.

clue.text: CD nearly damaged — use solvent to remove dirt

indicators.note: damaged means broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A disc almost ruined needs cleaning with chemicals.
explanation.definitionFit: Garments are cleaned with chemical solvents rather than water.
